samples.question: The triangle is the factual run; dark means ON. Each lower cell applies its row rule to the touching pair above. Make a RED run by flipping only the red-ringed TOP cell, and a BLUE run by flipping only the blue-ringed TOP cell. Record each letter's value in both runs. Then restore TOP. Test one card: at each listed letter, install its value from the run named by the card, then continue downward. Which card recreates the bottom made by flipping BOTH ringed TOP cells? Answer card-1, card-2, card-3, or card-4.
